cycle_consequences.conditional_on_X02: every primitive positive cycle is critical, L=ceil(q*log2(3))
cycle_consequences.unconditional: every primitive positive noncritical cycle has minimum m<2^49

fixed_weight_formula.meaning: number of integers in the common affine image interval; an upper bound, not a claim of attainability

private_digest_diagnostic.acceptance_role: none; the supplied note did not define its serialization

recurrences.A_N: sum_s min(binomial(N,s),A_m) when m<N, otherwise binomial(N,s)
recurrences.O_N: sum_(s>=1) min(binomial(N-1,s-1),A_m) when m<N, otherwise binomial(N-1,s-1)
recurrences.odd_image_recursion_uses: A_m, because time-N images need not be odd

row_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON of rows [N,decimal(A_N),decimal(O_N)] with decimal values stored as strings, separators ',' and ':' and no trailing newline
